typography.gate_note: TextFit.need() only requires h >= fontSize for one line, but the renderer's line box is 1.45 em, so single-line boxes sized to h == fontSize are vertically clipped (seen on v01: the totals amounts lost their lower half). generate_a11.py therefore gates every text box on hh(size, lines) = round(size * 1.45 * lines).

money.tax_order: subtotal -> minus discount -> tax on discounted base -> plus untaxed shipping

parser_findings: <RichText> / <TextSpan> do not exist in the class-DOM parser (probes p01, p02: HTTP 400 PARSE_ERROR Unknown element tag).
Inline mixed-style text = outer <Text fontSize fontFamily textAlign> whose children are <Raw text=... color=... fontSize=... fontFamily=.../> runs; they share one baseline naturally (probe p03).

The parser trims plain text nodes (probe p04: 'L1 ' lost its trailing space) and does NOT decode entities (text="A<B" prints the literal <). So every fidelity-sensitive string goes through <Raw text="..."/> with raw <, >, &, \. Backslashes survive.

decimal_column.method: for each amount row take the ink columns in a window around the right edge: the right edge must agree across rows within 1.5px, and ink width / character count must give one monospaced advance within 0.6px. Rows: the 4 line amounts plus the 6 totals amounts.

assertions.note: row 1 is 'A < B & C > D': if the parser had written < & > the ink width would far exceed len(text) monospaced advances. Row 0 has '  ' (two spaces) after 批次： - a 2x gap proves the double space was kept, which a trimmed text node would have lost.
